name: Rosewood Schloss Fuschl
positioning: Lakeside castle hotel on Lake Fuschl near Salzburg, with regional dining, lakefront rooms, suites and chalets, and the Asaya Spa
best_for: Travelers who want lake views and regional Salzkammergut cooking
Guests who enjoy guided hikes and lake experiences

facts.text: Schloss Restaurant serves Salzkammergut dishes with fresh local ingredients and curated wines in a relaxed fine dining setting.
Seeterrasse has Lake Fuschl views and serves global cuisine made from fresh local ingredients.
Vinothek is a cozy alpine lodge serving Austrian food and local wines, a relaxed spot for guests and hikers.
See Club is a lakeside spot serving fresh seafood and grill specialties by the water.
The lakefront rooms have marble bathrooms with rain showers and sofas.
Suites have private terraces or patios.
Accommodation also includes houses and chalets.
Signature Suites have a heritage style inspired by imperial refinement.
Asaya Spa has a winter garden retreat and offers massages and facials.
Guests can join herbal expert Martina on a hike to learn about regional herbs and then make their own herbal salt.
The hotel has its own bee colony, whose honey is served at breakfast and sold in the boutique.
Rosa Salon is an intimate space for private dining or meetings.

highlights.text: The hotel's fisherman, Gerhard, has worked Lake Fuschl since the 1980s and supplies smoked lake-to-table fish.
The Hidden Gems of Lake Fuschl experience combines a hike, a ride on a traditional Zille boat and a lake-to-plate visit to the historic Schloss fishery.
The Schloss Bar includes the historic Whiskey Room for intimate gatherings.
Sisi Teesalon serves handmade cakes and pralines with daily afternoon tea and becomes a bar in the evening.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the lakeside location means you need transportation to reach urban amenities.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the castle setting.
